newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Feb 3.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Fahd and Yemeni President Ali Abdullah Saleh reaffirmed their commitment to end a border dispute between the two countries.
- Saudi businessmen plan to form an international company to promote investments in the former Soviet republics.
- Bangladesh is seeking a 106 million riyal loan from the Saudi Development Fund to finance development projects.
- Ukraine's ambassador to Saudi Arabia discussed boosting trade relations with Saudi officials from the eastern province chamber of commerce.
